coder_notes: Solid-tumour basket; glioblastoma named in conditions and inclusion as 'Recurrent GBM (IDH wild type)' (cns5). IDH-wildtype defines GBM only, not candidate-matched. The GBM cohort itself has no candidate-matched selection: CDKN2A/B deletion applies only to IDH-mutant astrocytoma, and CDK pathway alteration only to mesothelioma/HNSCC/sarcoma/NSCLC; both coded eligibility + candidate-matched with uncertain flags because they are disease-subgroup requirements outside GBM. HR+/ER+ and KRAS/SMARCA4 selections for non-CNS cohorts coded not matched (record states no mechanistic link); an adjudicator may consider HR+ breast cancer linked to CDK4/6 inhibition. Pharmacodynamic sample type for pRb not stated. Plasma-only PK. Tissue sample required at screening.
